name: IMAP Email Action Pattern
description: Move or mark emails using IMAP (move to folder, mark as read)
explanation:
Pattern for email actions: move to folder or mark as read.

Action: move
- folder: Source folder (e.g., 'INBOX')
- targetFolder: Destination folder (e.g., 'Spam', 'Archive', 'General')
- emailUid: Email UID to move (use {{context.currentEmail.uid}} in loops)

Action: markRead
- folder: Folder containing the email
- uidToMark: Email UID to mark as read

Gmail folder mapping (automatic):
- 'Spam' → '[Gmail]/Spam'
- 'Trash' → '[Gmail]/Trash'
- 'Archive' → '[Gmail]/All Mail'

Template variables:
- {{context.currentEmail.uid}}: Current email UID in ForEach loop
- {{context.imapResult.emails[0].uid}}: First email UID
